_: Wed 30 Sep 2026 · market slot. Figures read directly off Redfin's Henry County page on 24 Sep 2026, not from a search summary — an FMLS-based report circulating the same week gives different numbers because it measures a single month, not a rolling three.
headline:
Homes Sold Faster
And Closer To Asking
asof: Henry County · three months ending August 2026
titan_line: Echo, two numbers from Redfin. The median home sold for **$333,883**, down 1.8% on a year ago. And homes sold after **61 days** on the market, against 85 days last year.
checks_rows: Homes closed at **98.3%** of list price — up 1.3 points
Redfin's median covers three months, not one
echo_line: Median? …Oh — the middle one. Half above, half below. So quicker, and nearer the asking number than last year. I'd still check my street.
source: Redfin · Henry County, GA housing market · retrieved September 24, 2026
disclaimer: County-wide figures for the period stated. Not an appraisal, a valuation, or a prediction for any individual property.
